smell_validity.evidence: Five pin-then-abandon experiments leave unreachable-but-referenced residue in the frame-update pipeline: dead branches, serving-only helpers, a never-drained buffer, an unconstructable enum variant, an orphaned pub(crate) predicate. Obsolescence rests on unreachable configuration, not absent callers, so the usual no-caller heuristic fails - the smell's central subtlety. Retired sides are meaningful rejected policies; cost and healthy-design boundary are unmistakable.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Phantom policy switches sit inside the crate's most-trafficked update functions (handle_event, push_event, DepthOrder::update, scroll State::update), forcing readers and editors to carry unreachable dual-model ceremony; the dead dim-tracking side drags an orphaned shared predicate and imports along. Removal restores single-policy ownership per responsibility, though the gain stays within this crate's update path.

development_plausibility.evidence: Retired functionality is credible and behavior-specific: retained depth merging motivated by DepthOrder::update's real cost FIXME, batched emission by scroll jitter, graph-derived dims by backend resize habits, each with a concrete rejection cause; shapes mirror real residue (pinned consts, helpers, buffer field). But five pristine, structurally parallel experiment clusters in one change shows a regularity ordinary evolution would not.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: Names all five affected areas, defines removal as a transitive closure (never-selected branches, unread buffers, unconstructed variants, helpers losing their last caller, non-load-bearing settings), and freezes public API, tests and live behavior. It decisively prevents incomplete cleanup ('no half-deleted planners, no erstwhile config'), wrong direction (anchored to never-executing code) and irrelevant redesign, without prescribing implementation.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Five distinct pipeline purposes (event ingestion, aggregation, render ordering, scroll state, shared predicate) need differing repairs: hoisting live guard sides, collapsing an enum match while rebinding around a shared clamp block, deleting a field plus its initializer, removing an orphan fn with imports. But the ui and depth clusters share one hoist decision, so not every purpose needs a unique decision.

localization_burden.evidence: Prompt names areas, not symbols; the solver reads five modules, finds the pinned selectors, and combines components to decide the utils predicate (its sole caller is ui.rs's dead branch) and confirm nothing drains pending_events. Live consts like SAFE_REDRAW_COUNT must be excluded via their use. No alias, callback or indirect selection mechanism is required.

repair_coordination.evidence: Clusters are mutually independent; within each, deletions must land as consistent groups (field with initializer, helper with its dead caller, enum with const and match, predicate with epsilon and imports), one cascade crossing files to the orphaned utils helper. But all couplings are definition/reference consistency exposed by the compiler or dead_code warnings, with no interacting behavioral rules.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: Residue stays reference-reachable: dead branches call their helpers and consts guard their branches, so dead-code/unused lints surface only the never-read field (still written by the dead path) and never-constructed variant (still named by a live match). Uniform deletion needs per-site polarity decisions (false/true/enum pins), no reconnect target exists, and shapes, side effects and orderings differ across clusters.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Flattening scroll's match while mistaking the arm's prev-bounds clamp for relocated ceremony compiles and matches ordinary scrolling, failing only when bounds change across updates - the documented jitter scenario. Retaining ui's graph-derived side mostly hides behind its fallback dims. Two hidden paths exist, but no supplied test or execution record establishes either is unchecked.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
